items.subject: english_core

decisive_support.quote: Transaction counts rose from 4.21 billion in October 2021 to 7.30 billion in 2022, 11.40 billion in 2023, and 16.58 billion in 2024.
Transaction value also rose: ₹7.71 lakh crore in 2021, ₹12.11 lakh crore in 2022, ₹17.15 lakh crore in 2023, and ₹23.49 lakh crore in 2024.

option_claim_checks.label: A
option_claim_checks.text: Both the number of transactions and the total value of transactions increase steadily over the four years.
option_claim_checks.reason: Each successive count and value is larger, using paragraphs 2 and 3 together.

option_claim_checks.label: B
option_claim_checks.text: The number of transactions increases, but the total value of transactions decreases year after year.
option_claim_checks.reason: The values rise, so the asserted fall is false.

option_claim_checks.label: C
option_claim_checks.text: The total value of transactions increases, but the number of transactions stays almost unchanged.
option_claim_checks.reason: The counts rise substantially, so they are not almost unchanged.

option_claim_checks.label: D
option_claim_checks.text: Both the number of transactions and the total value of transactions decrease after an initial increase.
option_claim_checks.reason: Both series rise throughout; neither shows the claimed decline.

items.language_note: The key is derivable from the complete stimulus, but the stem specifically refers to paragraph 3, which contains only the value series. This construction mismatch must be resolved before treating the item as a clean valid root.

decisive_support.quote: At dusk, Pip is alone in a marsh churchyard near the sea.
Pip is cold, wet, shaking and afraid.
Keep still, or I’ll make you pay!

option_claim_checks.label: A
option_claim_checks.text: The harsh setting near the sea
option_claim_checks.reason: The lonely, cold marsh setting emphasises exposure.

option_claim_checks.label: B
option_claim_checks.text: The man’s threatening behaviour
option_claim_checks.reason: The man seizes Pip and threatens a consequence.

option_claim_checks.label: C
option_claim_checks.text: Pip’s helpless fear
option_claim_checks.reason: Cold, shaking, afraid and helpless explicitly establish vulnerability.

option_claim_checks.label: D
option_claim_checks.text: Pip’s knowledge of the surrounding area
option_claim_checks.reason: Knowledge of the area is not described; this is the exception, without asserting that Pip lacks such knowledge.

decisive_support.quote: Keep still, or I’ll make you pay!

option_claim_checks.label: A
option_claim_checks.text: caution
option_claim_checks.reason: A caution warns of danger; this speaker promises an adverse consequence he will impose.

option_claim_checks.label: B
option_claim_checks.text: threat
option_claim_checks.reason: The conditional adverse consequence imposed by the speaker is a threat.

option_claim_checks.label: C
option_claim_checks.text: prediction
option_claim_checks.reason: A neutral prediction does not capture the speaker threatening to act.

option_claim_checks.label: D
option_claim_checks.text: announcement
option_claim_checks.reason: A neutral announcement does not capture the conditional threat.

decisive_support.quote: Tell us your name! Quick! Give it mouth!

option_claim_checks.label: A
option_claim_checks.text: Speak louder
option_claim_checks.reason: Nothing in the stimulus says Pip answered too quietly.

option_claim_checks.label: B
option_claim_checks.text: Open his mouth wide
option_claim_checks.reason: The surrounding demand concerns providing his name, not a physical mouth-opening exercise.

option_claim_checks.label: C
option_claim_checks.text: Answer the question
option_claim_checks.reason: The command follows a request for Pip’s name, so it asks him to answer.

decisive_support.quote: A rough, frightened-looking man with an iron on his leg seizes him and turns him so Pip must look up helplessly.
The man asks about a file and food, then orders Pip to bring both the next morning.

option_claim_checks.label: A
option_claim_checks.text: Pip’s encounter with a frightening man who demands information
option_claim_checks.reason: The encounter and the man’s demands form the action across the stimulus.

option_claim_checks.label: B
option_claim_checks.text: the harshness of Pip’s environment and the fear it creates
option_claim_checks.reason: The setting contributes to the encounter but does not capture the main action.

option_claim_checks.label: C
option_claim_checks.text: Pip’s struggle to understand the man’s intentions and stay calm
option_claim_checks.reason: The passage does not narrate an attempt to understand intentions or stay calm.

option_claim_checks.label: D
option_claim_checks.text: the importance of family relationships in Pip’s life
option_claim_checks.reason: Family relationships are absent.

Preferences varied by region.
The researchers suggested that later studies could examine gender, emerging industries and technology’s effects on work.

option_claim_checks.reason: The purpose is explicitly addressed.

option_claim_checks.label: B

option_claim_checks.label: C

option_claim_checks.reason: Varied demographics and regional variation are mentioned, though demographic effects are not analysed.

option_claim_checks.label: D
